what: The strokes of the wordmark SVG are split into two groups and wiped from opposite sides — group a (thin strokes·dots) is revealed from the right end to the left, group b (thick strokes) from the left end to the right, as the clip widens, together over 1.6s power3.inOut. Starts on one of: right on attach, once when visible, or the caller-side signal (fx:play)

options.start: load (default, as soon as it attaches)·scroll (once when visible — needs ScrollTrigger)·event (when fx:play is fired on the element, delay via detail.delay · on fx:done it jumps to the fully revealed state)
options.at: ScrollTrigger start when scroll, default top bottom
options.[data-fx-part=a]: Stroke group (g) revealed from right to left
options.[data-fx-part=b]: Stroke group (g) revealed from left to right

use: <svg viewBox="0 0 543 216" data-fx="split-stroke-wipe" data-fx-split-stroke-wipe="start: scroll"><g data-fx-part="a">Thin stroke</g><g data-fx-part="b">Bold Stroke</g></svg>

from.where: index.html hero wordmark (start: event — .6s after the intro) · shared.js footer big wordmark (start: scroll, top bottom, once) — original clip-group1 x 543→0 · width 0→543, clip-group2 width 0→543, 1.6s power3.inOut
